name: CM.com N.V.
summary: CM.com N.V. provides cloud software for conversational commerce worldwide. The company operates in four segments: Connect, Engage, Pay and Live. The company offers HALO Al agents, Al engine for 1:1 personalization, and customer data platform for unified customer profiles; service cloud, a shared agent inbox; marketing cloud for marketing campaigns; event app, a festival and event app, and event marketing for data driven communication; business messaging, one time password, and verification APIs; SIP trunking and voice API; online payments For webshops and e-commerce; in-person payments for fixed and mobile terminals; ticketing for ticket sales and registrations; and cash register for cashles…
